description: Find schools near a postcode, town, city or district in England or Wales (Northern Ireland postcodes are not loaded). Returns each school's phase, type, distance, latest Ofsted outcome and headline results compared with similar schools, with a link to its page.

admissions.description: all, selective (grammar schools) or non_selective (default all)

exclude_concern.description: Leave out schools Ofsted has placed in a category of concern

gender.description: all, mixed, girls or boys (default all)

limit.description: Most schools to return, nearest first, 1 to 100 (default 25)

location.description: A UK postcode such as SW1A 1AA, or a town, city or district in England such as Harrogate

phase.description: all, nursery, primary, secondary or sixteen_plus (default all)

school_type.description: all, state, academy, la_maintained, special or independent (default all)

sen_provision.description: Only schools with an SEN unit or resourced provision

name: find_schools
